summary: Iteration 41 — Frontend E2E for (a) brand-filter chips on /search (toners), /consumables, /scanners, (b) line-art placeholder images on consumables, and (c) Procurement Phase 2 order flow (place order from quotation → My Orders timeline → admin advance → procurement-side timeline reflects advance). ALL REQUESTED FLOWS PASS LIVE.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandChips.jsx — chips are correctly inline-styled (background=brand color when active, white with colored border when inactive). aria-pressed wired. value/onChange staying in sync with parent Brand select state verified on /search, /consumables and /scanners.

Consumables.jsx — visible.length-based empty state shows [data-testid='consumables-empty'] when HP filter yields 0; All/Xerox both show 5 cards (Xerox B305 fusers/drums/maintenance kit). consumable-placeholder-image renders red XEROX line-art band on cards and on the detail page inside [data-testid='product-image-main'] (no 'No image uploaded' fallback).

MyQuotations.jsx — Place-order button only appears for quotations with status='active'; after order placement, the source quotation becomes 'converted' and the button is correctly removed. Confirmed: QT-2026-000002 status moved to 'converted' and place-order button count went from 1 → 0.

MyOrders.jsx — auto-switches to orders section on successful placement (onOrdered callback in ProcurementDashboard.jsx line 50 fires setSection('orders')). Timeline [data-testid='proc-order-timeline-PO-2026-000002'] showed step 1 (CONFIRMED) initially; after 2 admin advances it shows CONFIRMED/PROCESSING/SHIPPED as completed and 'DELIVERED' as pending. payment_status badge ('Unpaid' amber) and total ₹4,484 wired correctly. Order also shows rank badge 'L1'.

PO upload UI correctly hidden for the corporate (Phase2 QA Pvt Ltd) account — only PO-2026-000001 (govt account) shows the PO column action in admin table. ProcurementTab.jsx OrdersSection correctly renders proc-admin-po-* only when po.po_path exists.

ProcurementTab.jsx OrdersSection — table [data-testid='proc-admin-orders'] lists both orders, org name 'Phase2 QA Pvt Ltd' present, status badge styling switches to emerald only on 'delivered' (verified PO-2026-000001 is emerald, PO-2026-000002 stays blue after shipped). proc-admin-advance-PO-2026-000002 click advanced confirmed→processing→shipped successfully, success toast 'PO-2026-000002 → shipped' visible.

Regression — toner /search cards still render red CANON / red XEROX line-art bands; Add-to-cart toast 'Added Canon CARTRIDGE CANON 071 to cart' fires correctly; 13-chip row + filter (Canon=19 cards, All=21) verified earlier in this run.
Minor a11y carryover from iter 40 — Radix DialogContent (proc-order-dialog, AgreementGate) still lacks aria-describedby; warning only, not blocking.
